summary.en: The change next to a figure: an arrow for the direction, a color for what it means, the amount in tabular figures and a sentence for screen readers. Direction and meaning are separate, because a falling number can be good news.
summary.id: Perubahan di samping sebuah angka: panah untuk arah, warna untuk artinya, jumlah dalam angka tabular, dan kalimat untuk pembaca layar. Arah dan arti dipisahkan, karena angka yang turun bisa jadi kabar baik.

en.title: Next to key figures
en.desc: Levy income rose (good), new applicants fell (bad), complaints fell (good, because fewer complaints is better), the completion rate stayed flat.
en.html:

New applicants1,234arrow_upward−20% down from last month
Complaints18arrow_upward−3 down from last month
Completed within SLA94.6%arrow_upward0.0 pt no change from last month

en.title: Pill, with a visible comparison
en.desc: `delta--pill` puts the delta on its tint where it sits beside a large number; `.delta__note` names the comparison once.
en.html: arrow_upward+8.2% up from October arrow_upward−4.1% down from October arrow_upward+320vs October up from October

en.title: Updating in place
en.desc: Press the button: `setDelta()` rewrites the amount, turns the arrow on a spring when the direction flips and recolors by meaning.
en.html: arrow_upward+4.2% up from last week

id.title: Pil, dengan pembanding yang terlihat
id.desc: `delta--pill` menaruh delta di atas tint-nya bila berada di samping angka besar; `.delta__note` menyebut pembandingnya sekali.

id.title: Diperbarui di tempat
id.desc: Tekan tombolnya: `setDelta()` menulis ulang jumlahnya, memutar panah dengan spring bila arahnya berbalik, dan mewarnai ulang menurut artinya.
